description:
## Why

An `AssistantMessage` carries multiple content blocks (`:text`, `:thinking`) that stream independently. The same three-slot shape from `opi-4dx.8` recurses inside the message: an order list of block ids, data keyed by id, renderers only while a block is streaming, rendered cached iolist per block.

Replaces the current `markdown_streams: %{idx => Stream.t}` map keyed by positional index — that map is the local symptom of "we don't have stable ids yet" and gets superseded by `opi-4dx.6`'s ids.

## Depends on

- `opi-4dx.6` (block ids from agent)
- `opi-4dx.7` (`Markdown.Render` is what populates `renderers` for `:text` blocks)

## Shape

`AssistantMessage` carries an embedded transcript-shaped struct keyed by content-block id. Could literally embed `%Transcript{}` from `.8` if the API generalizes, or hold its own `%AssistantMessage.Blocks{}` mirror — pick whichever is cleaner; the data shape is identical.

`:thinking` blocks have a trivial renderer (one wrap pass over the text); `:text` blocks use `Markdown.Render` from `.7`.

## Code references

- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/assistant_message.ex` — entire file restructured.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/markdown/stream.ex` — gone after `.7`; AssistantMessage uses the new renderer.

## Acceptance

- `AssistantMessage.render/2` on a message with all blocks finalized emits cached iolist verbatim — no re-walk, no telemetry `markdown.render` span fires.
- `AssistantMessage.update_content` on one block doesn't touch the other blocks' state.
- Mixed `:text` / `:thinking` ordering preserved across renders.
- Removing `markdown_streams` field; replacing with the new shape.

## Tests

- Unit tests: append text block; update twice; finalize; assert renderer dropped from in-flight set; assert subsequent renders emit zero new lines and reuse cached.
- Mixed-content test: a thinking block at idx 0, text block at idx 1, second text block at idx 2 — assert independent render state per block.

## Out of scope

- Interactive wiring (lives in `.10`).
title: AssistantMessage: nest the Transcript shape for content blocks
